sources.title: End-Use Load Profiles for the U.S. Building Stock, 2021 TMY3 New York aggregates
sources.selection: All fourteen New York ComStock building-class aggregates plus the ResStock Multi-Family with 5+ Units aggregate; exact object URLs and SHA-256 values are recorded by prepare_background_profiles.py.
sources.time_basis: source interval-ending TMY3 shape is remapped to 2025 interval-starting local-standard-time timestamps; it is not treated as measured 2018 demand

sources.title: ISO New England 2025 SMD Hourly Data
sources.local_role: exogenous final hourly real-time LMP expanded piecewise-constantly to 15-minute intervals
sources.resolution_caveat: This annual workbook is hourly. It is not described as five-minute data and no within-hour price variation is invented.
sources.causal_caveat: Historical 2025 prices are not claimed to be causally paired with TMY weather.

sources.title: ISO New England 2025 Five-Minute Reserve Zone Prices and Designations
sources.local_role: TMSR, TMNSR, and TMOR reserve-zone price and designation series aggregated arithmetically from 5 to 15 minutes
sources.field_caveat: The published desg_mw fields are reserve designations, not reserve requirements.

provenance_rule: Every downloaded or derived file must appear in a local asset manifest with SHA-256, source URL, retrieval time, transformation command, time semantics, and software version. Generated or synthetic fields must be labelled and must not be attributed to an external source.
